title: Paul Dean - Picking up the Pieces: Building Story in a Roguelike World
speaker: Paul Dean
talk_title: Picking up the Pieces: Building Story in a Roguelike World
description: Nebula-nominated games writer Paul Dean talks about linearity and non-linearity in both narrative and the writing process itself. He investigates where exactly a narrative begins and ends, as well as how this factors into his writing process and how it was applied in his work on Pacific Drive and other games.
